'''Dovin Maur''' was an old [[Gender/Legends|man]] who claimed to have survived the beginning of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] and [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] destruction of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Maur revered the Jedi and after relocating to [[Lazerian IV]], he did not reveal the location of the [[Ruined outpost|Jedi ruins]] on the continent of [[Laz]].
